title: Credit Risk — Portfolio Dashboard (IFRS9 / RAROC / Vintage)

panels.title: IFRS 9 Stage Mix

targets.rawSql: SELECT ifrs9_stage AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM risk.expected_loss GROUP BY ifrs9_stage

panels.description: Stage 1 = 12-mo ECL (performing) | Stage 2/3 = Lifetime ECL (SICR triggered)

panels.title: Total ECL by Stage ($M)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ifrs9_stage AS metric, SUM(expected_loss)/1e6 AS value FROM risk.expected_loss GROUP BY ifrs9_stage ORDER BY ifrs9_stage

panels.description: ECL provision in $M per IFRS 9 stage

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Mean PD' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(pd)*100,2) AS value FROM risk.expected_loss UNION ALL SELECT 'Mean LGD', ROUND(AVG(lgd)*100,2) FROM risk.expected_loss UNION ALL SELECT 'EL Rate%', ROUND(AVG(el_rate)*100,2) FROM risk.expected_loss UNION ALL SELECT 'Total EAD $B', ROUND(SUM(ead)/1e9,2) FROM risk.expected_loss

panels.title: Expected Loss by Risk Class

targets.rawSql: SELECT risk_class, SUM(expected_loss) AS total_el, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM risk.expected_loss GROUP BY risk_class ORDER BY risk_class

panels.description: EL concentration by internal risk grade (AA = best, F = worst)

targets.rawSql: SELECT decision AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM risk.expected_loss GROUP BY decision
SELECT risk_class, AVG(annualized_roi) AS mean_raroc FROM risk.expected_loss GROUP BY risk_class ORDER BY risk_class

panels.title: Scoring Volume (Last 30 days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', calc_date::timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*) AS loans_scored FROM risk.expected_loss WHERE calc_date::timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Daily scoring throughput — confirms pipeline is running
